# appendonly_set (Resource)

Tracks a set of string values permanently. Values added to `values` accumulate in `result` over time and are never removed, even if omitted from future configurations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appendonly_set" "example" {
  values = ["a", "b", "c"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `values` (Set of String) The set of string values to track.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A static value used internally by Terraform, this should not be referenced in configurations.
- `result` (Set of String) The accumulated union of all values ever provided.
